explication: PipesHub is an open-source workplace AI platform that indexes enterprise systems and answers permission-aware questions with citations. The principal workflow is: a user authenticates, submits search or chat, retrieval filters graph-backed records by access, an LLM generates an answer, and citations are returned. Distinct stages include administration, connector scheduling/indexing, document storage, retrieval, and response delivery. The tree supports these boundaries, while several service-to-service links are inferred from module names and README capabilities rather than sampled implementations.
